text: Operator compatibility constraint after plan review: preserve existing public ConsumerDescriptor::get_instance_specifier signature; do not replace it with Result. Use an additive fallible accessor (with a provided default for existing implementors) for absent producer specifier, and add actual concrete identity access if needed. Any legacy accessor limitation must be explicit in implementation/docs and final gaps; do not fabricate a producer specifier or claim all accessors are non-panicking. Specific API source compatibility is required. Runtime-owned storage allocates on first query unless explicitly initialized beforehand; avoid asserting zero runtime allocation. Adding virtual IRuntime methods changes vtable ABI even if source-compatible mocks get a default; document this accurately. Make proposed implementation decisions within authority; no approval/wait nodes. Retained-result lifetime refinement remains mandatory.
